transcript.title: Add a host
transcript.text: From the Host List, tap the plus button to add a host.

transcript.title: Enter the connection details
transcript.text: In Quick connect, enter your username, server address, and optionally port, like demo@example.com. Remember, this is only an example host, so you must replace these example details with your own. Port 22 is the usual SSH port.
transcript.spoken: In Quick connect, enter your username, server address, and optionally port. For example: demo, at, example dot com. Remember, this is only an example host, so you must replace these example details with your own. Port twenty-two is the usual SSH port.

transcript.title: Save the host
transcript.text: Tap Add host to save the connection.

transcript.title: Find your saved host
transcript.text: The saved host appears in the Host List. Simply tap it when you are ready to connect.
